# Deleting Automatically Generated Cables

The automatically generated cables and [connection definition points](Glossary_o_verbindungsdefinitionspunkte.htm) can be deleted either for the entire project or for the selection.

Precondition:

You have opened a project.

1. Select one or several cables in the graphical editor or the [cable](Glossary_o_kabel.htm) navigator. Or select in the page navigator one or several project pages or a project.
2. Select the Project data > Cables > Delete automatically generated cables menu [items](Glossary_o_bauteile.htm).
3. If necessary, select the Apply to entire project check box.
4. Click [OK].  
     
   ![](../Pictures/Gui/ALL/arrow.png) All [cable definition lines](Glossary_o_kabeldefinitionslinien.htm) and connection definition points marked as automatically generated are deleted. Moreover, automatically assigned device tags on manually drawn cable definition [lines](Glossary_o_leitungen.htm) or connection definition points are deleted. The manual cable definition lines and connection definition points remain untouched.
